review_questions: Does session expiry keep retained draft text hidden until same-owner reconciliation and prevent a different owner from receiving draft-specific information?
Do unload and logout guards surface unsaved work only for the authenticated owner while covering dirty, error, conflict, blocked, quarantined, and unresolved-command states?
Do logout cancellation, failure, success, and expiry during pending logout preserve intended generation, auth, cache, draft, and sync behavior?
Do account refresh and router expiry handling keep private drafts inaccessible in the guest shell and allow same-owner reconciliation after login?

satisfied_questions: App tests cover unload listener cleanup and logout cancel, failure, and success outcomes.
The guard confirms before logout, retains state on failure, and removes its unload listener on unmount.
An expired account context redirects to login while the draft remains quarantined and inaccessible.
A 401 refresh clears visible account context while retaining the draft only in quarantined memory.
Failed logout and expiry during pending logout do not prematurely advance generation or clear private state.
Logout clearing waits for API success and session expiry is distinguished from explicit logout.
Tests cover same-owner reconciliation, epoch quarantine, 401 stop, locked writes, owner-keyed lookup, and risky states.
Expired drafts remain hidden until reconciliation and reads stay keyed by owner identity.

findings.issue: After session expiry, reset(session_expired) retains old-owner records as quarantined and needsAttention counts quarantined records as unsaved. If another owner signs in in the same tab, owner-keyed lookup keeps the old text hidden, but hasUnsavedDrafts scans every record and returns true. AppShell uses that global result for beforeunload and logout confirmation, so the new owner receives a warning about work that is not theirs.
findings.evidence: The supplied journalDrafts.ts hunk adds needsAttention(quarantined), session-expiry retention, and hasUnsavedDrafts over Object.values(drafts.value). resourceKey/getCurrentKey at frontend/src/stores/journalDrafts.ts:49-50,80-83 keep records keyed to their original owner; reset at :589-600 retains and quarantines them. frontend/src/components/AppShell.vue:26-28,41-43 uses hasUnsavedDrafts for unload and logout. frontend/src/stores/auth.ts:18-36 invokes the session-expiry reset; frontend/src/stores/account.ts:22-47 and frontend/src/router/index.ts:35-70 allow a new authenticated owner to reach the shell while the Pinia draft store remains mounted. The existing owner test at frontend/src/stores/__tests__/journalDrafts.spec.ts:152-163 checks getDraft isolation but not the new guard aggregation.
findings.requiredCorrection: Scope hasUnsavedDrafts to records owned by the currently authenticated owner while preserving the same owner’s quarantine and uncertain-write warning. Add an expiry -> different-owner login regression asserting the old draft neither appears nor triggers beforeunload/logout confirmation, while same-owner risky work remains guarded.
